description: Sends a bug report, feature request or general feedback to EasyGerber only when the user asks or agrees to report it. Send only the approved message; never automatically attach private board content, raw diagnostics, transcripts or exports. No account, board or guest session is required. A connected account attributes the report to that account; otherwise an optional existing guestToken attributes it to that guest. Reuse requestId with the identical category and message on retries. Returns a submission receipt, without promising a response. Account feedback is limited to 10/hour and 50/day; guest and anonymous feedback share those limits by network.

category.description: bug reports a problem; feature_request proposes a change; general shares other EasyGerber feedback.

guestToken.description: Optional existing guest-session capability for attribution when no account is connected. Omit for anonymous or account feedback; never start a session solely to submit feedback or print this token. Invalid tokens are rejected.

message.description: User-approved feedback, 10–2000 Unicode characters after trimming. Include only what the user agreed to send; do not automatically include private board content, credentials, transcripts or diagnostics.

requestId.description: Unique UUID for this report. Reuse it with the identical category and message after an uncertain result; use a new UUID for a different report.

name: submit_feedback
title: Submit EasyGerber feedback
